_comment: Example config for publish-core-30-page.py. Copy to ev-electric.config.json (gitignored) and edit. The application password lives in $WP_APP_PASSWORD, not here.
_comment_gsc: OPTIONAL. When true, every publish auto-submits the live URL to the GSC Indexing API via Application Default Credentials (ADC) — no key files. One-time per-Mac setup, and the same 2 commands for any later re-auth: gcloud auth application-default login --scopes=https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform,https://www.googleapis.com/auth/indexing,https://www.googleapis.com/auth/webmasters + gcloud auth application-default set-quota-project keelworks-seo-automation. The gcloud-authed account must be Owner on the client's GSC property. See sop-gsc-indexing-api-setup.md (quick-reference box at the top). Omit or set to false to keep the manual click-through-GSC workflow.
